definition.name: Exact reviewed tag and CI gate

steps.name: Require selected exact identity, successful CI and declared predecessor
steps.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
arguments=()
if test "$PUBLISH" = true; then arguments+=(--publish); fi
python3 tools/native_release_gate.py --version "$NATIVE_VERSION" --commit "$REVIEWED_COMMIT" \
  --ci-run "$REVIEWED_CI_RUN" --predecessor-run "$PREDECESSOR_RUN" "${arguments[@]}" \
  --output "$PWD/target/native-release-decision.json" --github-output

reviewReason: Lossless sharding of the reviewed v1 inventory; owner fingerprints remain enforced.
